# YOLOv12-n-seg

Instance Segmentation · `yolov12-seg-n_640x640` · DX-APP Python example

Instance Segmentation model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite

![YOLOv12-n-seg output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov12_seg_n_640x640
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/instance_segmentation/yolov12_seg/yolov12-seg-n_640x640/yolov12-seg-n_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov12-seg-n_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov12-seg-n_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolov12-seg-n_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov12-seg-n_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```
